method: Live primary-document review; summaries are semantic support, not official attack verdicts.

sources.supports: Extension queries underlying graphics-driver descriptions. Ordinary renderer/vendor strings may be masked for privacy; extension exposure is a browser choice.
sources.does_not_support: Physical GPU attestation, exact Native/Web string equality, or declaring a vendor an attack.

sources.version: Live main document; immutable revision not pinned
sources.supports: SwiftShader renders using the CPU. Chromium distinguishes a GLES-driver mode from WebGL fallback mode.
sources.does_not_support: All Native/Web contexts use the same physical hardware, or software rendering is an attack.

sources.version: Live main document; immutable revision not pinned
sources.supports: ANGLE translates GLES to several backends; the platform table includes Android GLES/Vulkan and desktop backends.
sources.does_not_support: ANGLE alone identifies Windows or manipulation; a reported backend string proves physical host or authorization.

sources.supports: Emulator rendering may use host GPU or supported software modes, including SwiftShader and ANGLE combinations.
sources.does_not_support: The device's guest Android OS uniquely determines physical GPU or renderer vocabulary.

sources.supports: A canvas initialized with one context type cannot be used to probe a different context type; getContext returns null for incompatible context mode.
sources.does_not_support: A false result from the existing same-canvas probe establishes lack of device WebGL2 capability.

retrieval_limitations.result: Browser research tool rejected application/xml; not used as a verified source. Native API calls are verified directly in repository collector source.
